$comment: The release-candidate tag the compat CREDENTIAL lanes run against (ADR-0056). null = no RC cut yet: the credential crons refuse rather than test main. Cutting an RC is a founder action: push the vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag, then bump rcTag here in a reviewed PR. scripts/compat-credential-ref.mjs resolves it.
$rcBumpMarkerComment: #1302 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/compat-credential-freeze-guard.yml refuses any PR touching a file the credential harness executes (derived, see docs/ci/credential-freeze-guard.md), unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: rcBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...' }. Add it in the SAME reviewed PR that needs to touch a frozen file mid-window; remove it once no longer needed.
